verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a macOS setting to disable analytics, diagnostics sharing or usage tracking. The only privacy mention covers password management and private browsing, which are adjacent features. Blocking ocsp.apple.com in /etc/hosts is a user-side workaround aimed at certificate checks, not telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
